title: The Sensitive Plant

title: Leaflet rustle (full and weak fold)
source: Synthesised for Taste in numpy: band-passed noise grains (2.2 to 9 kHz) over a soft air bed, crowded toward the start like the arriving wave
license: Original, made for this component (no recording)
note: Script kept in the builder's scratch folder; 44.1 kHz mono 16-bit.

title: Mimosa pudica frond, specimen photograph
prompt: a single fresh frond of Mimosa pudica sensitive plant, bipinnate leaf with four pinnae of many small paired leaflets fully open, photographed flat from directly above on plain white paper, botanical specimen photograph, crisp even light, isolated --ar 1:1 --style raw
note: Used only as a colour reference: leaflet greens were sampled from its pixels (10th/50th/90th percentile of leaf pixels, roughly #2e4c1d, #4b6a1d, #748f3a) and the reddish pulvini and paler rachis were matched by eye. Its leaf architecture is wrong (eight pinnae; the real plant has one or two pairs held digitately at the petiole tip), so none of its geometry or pixels is used.
